svg.title: Strobe tuner audio signal path
svg.desc: On the audio thread the microphone input is converted to mono 48 kHz by miniaudio and written into two lock-free ring buffers. On the main thread the pitch detector reads one every display frame, high-passes it at 60 Hz and low-passes it at 5 kHz, runs the NSDF and picks the target note once it has held for 50 ms, which retunes the strobe bands. The strobe reads the other every display frame: a Blackman windowed single-bin DFT per band, a lock-in rotation on the absolute sample clock and a Kalman tracker drive the strobe shader, with each band's noise floor giving the SNR.

g.text: follows the band level in dB while it's quiet
its SNR weights the tracker and fades the stripes
